Jasmine — attaching the export and a short DPIA checklist. See attached files: tag-inventory.csv, dpia-checklist.docx.

Summary highlights:
- Inventory contains 37 distinct tags (analytics, A/B testing, error reporting, ad pixels, chat widget).
- Tags that can capture user-entered health info: chat widget (Intercom), form analytics (Hotjar-style); both can capture free-text if site form fields accept symptom or appointment text. We do not intentionally send PHI to analytics endpoints, but user-entered text can be captured by session replay/config if enabled.
- We have session-replay disabled on all health-sensitive pages per policy, and form-field masking is enabled for fields with keywords ("appointment", "symptom", "patient id").
- Data retention: analytics cookies retained 13 months by default; error logs 90 days; contact form submissions forwarded to CRM (HubSpot) and retained per HubSpot settings.

Action items I included in the dpia-checklist.docx:
1) Confirm session-replay toggles on pilot pages (I recommend they stay off).
2) Add explicit cookie banner text around health data and contact forms for the pilot.
3) Provide a short SOP for incident escalation if PHI is observed.

Let me know if you want me to redline the cookie policy text.

- Mina
